verses.english: Linked Discourses 35.129
13. Householders
With Ghosita

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṁ viharati ghositārāme.
verses.english: At one time Venerable Ānanda was staying near Kosambī, in Ghosita’s Monastery.

verses.pali: Atha kho ghosito gahapati yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṁ nisinno kho ghosito gahapati āyasmantaṁ ānandaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then the householder Ghosita went up to Venerable Ānanda, and said to him:
“Honorable Ānanda, they speak of ‘the diversity of elements’.

verses.pali: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, dhātunānattaṁ vuttaṁ bhagavatā”ti?
verses.english: In what way did the Buddha speak of the diversity of elements?”

verses.pali: “Saṁvijjati kho, gahapati, cakkhudhātu, rūpā ca manāpā, cakkhuviññāṇañca sukhavedaniyaṁ.
verses.english: “Householder, the eye element is found, as are agreeable sights, and eye consciousness.
Pleasant feeling arises dependent on a contact to be experienced as pleasant.

verses.pali: Saṁvijjati kho, gahapati, cakkhudhātu, rūpā ca amanāpā, cakkhuviññāṇañca dukkhavedaniyaṁ.
verses.english: The eye element is found, as are disagreeable sights, and eye consciousness.
Painful feeling arises dependent on a contact to be experienced as painful.

verses.pali: Saṁvijjati kho, gahapati, cakkhudhātu, rūpā ca manāpā upekkhāvedaniyā, cakkhuviññāṇañca adukkhamasukhavedaniyaṁ.
verses.english: The eye element is found, as are sights that are a basis for equanimity, and eye consciousness.
Neutral feeling arises dependent on a contact to be experienced as neutral.

verses.pali: saṁvijjati kho, gahapati, jivhādhātu, rasā ca manāpā, jivhāviññāṇañca sukhavedaniyaṁ.
verses.english: The ear … nose … tongue … body …

verses.pali: Saṁvijjati kho, gahapati, jivhādhātu, rasā ca amanāpā, jivhāviññāṇañca dukkhavedaniyaṁ.
Saṁvijjati kho, gahapati, jivhādhātu, rasā ca upekkhāvedaniyā, jivhāviññāṇañca adukkhamasukhavedaniyaṁ.
saṁvijjati kho, gahapati, manodhātu, dhammā ca manāpā, manoviññāṇañca sukhavedaniyaṁ.
verses.english: mind element is found, as are agreeable ideas, and mind consciousness.
Pleasant feeling arises dependent on a contact to be experienced as pleasant.

verses.pali: Saṁvijjati kho, gahapati, manodhātu, dhammā ca amanāpā, manoviññāṇañca dukkhavedaniyaṁ.
verses.english: The mind element is found, as are disagreeable ideas, and mind consciousness.
Painful feeling arises dependent on a contact to be experienced as painful.

verses.pali: Saṁvijjati kho, gahapati, manodhātu, dhammā ca upekkhāvedaniyā, manoviññāṇañca adukkhamasukhavedaniyaṁ.
verses.english: The mind element is found, as are ideas that are a basis for equanimity, and mind consciousness.
Neutral feeling arises dependent on a contact to be experienced as neutral.

verses.pali: Ettāvatā kho, gahapati, dhātunānattaṁ vuttaṁ bhagavatā”ti.
verses.english: This is how the Buddha spoke of the diversity of elements.”
